body.message:
Unfortunately, we are unable to offer a rate below AED 10,000, as this is a 2-bedroom apartment. This is the best rate we can provide at the moment.

However, if you are comfortable with a monthly rate of AED 10,000, I can check with our management if we can offer the same rate for a 3-month stay and will update you accordingly.

Please let us know if you would like us to proceed. Thank you for your understanding.
